title: Some Things No Amount of Money Can Ever Replace #gratitude #appreciation #humanity
description:
Some Things No Amount of Money Can Ever Replace.

Money can replace almost anything except the moments, voices, and memories that become part of who we are. We often don’t realize their true value until they’re almost gone, reminding us that the most precious things in life were never meant to have a price tag. Whether it’s an old message, a family photo, or time with someone you love, some treasures only grow more valuable with time. In the end, the most valuable things we ever have are the ones we’ll never be able to replace.

Movie: Forever My Girl

#gratitude #appreciation #humanity #memories #lifelessons #humanbehavior #psychology #movieclips #shorts

When my dad died, I had his computer, and that was one thing.

But what I needed more, was his voice.

Honestly, I find myself reflecting on why it is I can't seem to accept anyone else in my life.

I think it's because I was raised by a man who held true wisdom, and showed me true change, connection, and empathy.

Meanwhile, everyone else I've met, among thousands of people, has fallen short of that.

It hurts, trying to become that kind of man, while surrounded by a society that celebrates ignorance.

I'm tired boss.

I'm so. So. Tired.
